title: A Laughlin gap stable under every small bounded scalar perturbation
exact_target: For the spherical fermionic $V_1$ pseudopotential at flux $Q=3(N-1)$, are there $\lambda _*,Delta_*>0$ and $N_*$ such that every real bounded measurable scalar phi with $||\phi ||_infinity\leq 1$ and every $|\lambda |\leq \lambda _*$ gives a unique ground state and spectral gap at least $Delta_*$ for $N\geq N_*$, when lambda times the projected one-body scalar potential is added?
